title: Harvard Summer School Program in Seoul
about: Harvard Summer School's study abroad programme in Seoul runs June 24 to August 19, 2027 at Ewha Womans University, for two semester-long courses of degree credit. The online application opens in early December 2026; deadline January 28, 2027.
requirements: Completed a year of college or be a first-year student, in good academic standing
card_alt: Card for the Harvard Summer School Program in Seoul by Harvard Summer School in Seoul, South Korea, application deadline 28 Jan 2027, with a photo of Gyeongbokgung Palace, Seoul.
